## Appearance

Anne possesses a thin figure and a delicate, bright face characterized by a nice nose and solemn, limpid, luminous gray eyes that dilate when she is emotional. Her face is pale and freckled, notably featuring seven small freckles across her nose, though her cheeks are sometimes flushed with pink above a slim, milk-white throat. Her distinctive hair is famously red, sometimes styled in long braids or worn in short, silky curls. Friends occasionally describe her hair as auburn or ruddy, though at one point it turned a dull, bronzy green with red streaks.

## Personality

A bright, diligent, and smart individual, she possesses a vivid imagination that can occasionally cause her to dread the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) after nightfall. Though initially known for being heedless, impulsive, and prone to making mistakes, she has matured into a steady, reliable person who nonetheless remains adventurous and dramatic. Driven by a deep optimism and a desire to add beauty and joy to the lives of others, she longs for everyone to love her and hopes to win Anthony's liking through patience. Her academic ambitions motivate her to win the Avery scholarship and pursue a college course at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) to learn how to best live life, help others, and understand herself. In addition to a knack with children, her skills include treating croup, rowing a dory, and having a good singing voice. She is also skilled at reading, memorizing, and publicly reciting poetry and dramatic pieces.

## History

An orphan from [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), Anne Shirley spent her early childhood living with Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md), and in an asylum at [Hopeton](../codex/places.md#hopeton) before being brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Though initially shocked to receive a girl instead of a boy, [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and his sister [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agreed to adopt her, giving Anne a permanent home where she formed an instant, lifelong friendship with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). Anne gradually won over the community despite early mishaps, including a fierce public outburst against Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and an incident where she smashed a slate over [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's head after he insulted her hair. Over the following years, Anne excelled academically under her teacher Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), entering a bitter scholastic rivalry with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) that culminated in them tying for first place on the Island's entrance exams. While attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), she won the prestigious Avery scholarship; however, following Matthew's sudden death and Marilla's failing health, Anne chose to forego college to stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). She took a position as the schoolteacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where she founded the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and formed a close bond with her student, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). During her tenure, she accidentally sold her neighbor Mr. Harrison's cow by mistake, but her quick apology helped spark a close friendship with him. Anne also played a key role in reuniting long-lost lovers [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), ultimately serving as an attendant at their wedding.

## Quotes

> "You can punish me in any way you like, Marilla. You can shut me up in a dark, damp dungeon inhabited by snakes and toads and feed me only on bread and water and I shall not complain. But I cannot ask Mrs. Lynde to forgive me."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P46](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0046)

> "Pretty well. I imagine a good deal, and that helps to pass the time. Of course, it’s rather lonesome. But then, I may as well get used to that."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P11](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0011)

> "I don’t get cross about other things; but I’m so tired of being twitted about my hair and it just makes me boil right over. Do you suppose my hair will really be a handsome auburn when I grow up?"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043)

> "I love pretty things; and I hate to look in the glass and see something that isn’t pretty. It makes me feel so sorrowful—just as I feel when I look at any ugly thing. I pity it because it isn’t beautiful."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P45](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0045)

> "I love Green Gables already, and I never loved any place before. No place ever seemed like home. Oh, Marilla, I’m so happy. I could pray right now and not find it a bit hard."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P49](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0049)

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) is the minister's wife and a trusted confidante to Anne. The two first bonded after Anne accidentally served Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) a liniment-flavored layer cake, prompting Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) to offer kind comfort over the honest mistake. Over time, Anne frequently turned to her for guidance on grief, ideals, and friendship.

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's closest friend and constant confidante, having sworn a solemn oath of friendship shortly after they met. Their bond was tested early on when Diana's mother temporarily separated them, but it was restored after Anne nursed Diana's sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through severe croup. They share countless outings, secrets, and imaginative adventures together.

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Anne originally treated [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as an enemy and refused to speak to him after he teased her about her hair, despite him rescuing her when her boat sank. Their fierce academic rivalry at school later transformed into a close friendship as they collaborated on community projects and shared teaching experiences, eventually giving rise to quiet romantic feelings.
